note.title: Sample text
note.text: This page is sample text written while Ticketzy is under development. It is not legal advice and not a real agreement. Ticketzy does not sell real tickets yet.

sections.title: About this service
p: Ticketzy is an event ticketing site under development. Payments are simulated for now and it does not sell real tickets yet.
Events, venues, organizers and prices may change while the project is being built.

sections.title: Accounts
p: You can browse events without an account. To buy tickets, like events or write comments you create a buyer account. To publish events you create an organizer account, which an administrator must verify.
list: Use an email address you can access, because it is your login.
Keep your password private. You are responsible for what happens under your account.
An administrator can reject or suspend an account that breaks these terms.

sections.title: Orders and payments
p: Payments are simulated for now. No card is charged, no money moves, and a paid order is only a record in the database.
list: The price shown is the price of the order. Ticketzy’s commission is taken from the organizer’s payout, it is not added to the buyer’s price.
Prices are shown in the currency of the event.
Each ticket has a QR code that works once, at check-in.

sections.title: Seat holds
p: Seats you pick are held for {{seconds}} seconds while you check out. This time is a server setting. An order that is not paid in time expires and its seats are released.
You can hold up to {{max}} seats at a time.

sections.title: Refunds
p: A paid order can be refunded as a whole, as long as none of its tickets has been used and its event is refundable, until 23:59 on the day the organizer set for that event (1 to 30 days before the event), in the time zone of the venue. The policy is shown on the event page and at checkout, and an order keeps the policy it was bought under. Tickets for a non-refundable event can’t be refunded; buyers confirm this before they pay. When an event is cancelled, its paid orders are refunded.

sections.title: Organizer responsibilities
p: Organizers are responsible for their events being accurate and taking place.
list: Give true titles, descriptions, dates, venues and prices.
Do not upload images or text you have no right to use.
Check attendees in with their QR codes.
Cancel an event as soon as you know it will not take place.
An administrator can reject, suspend or cancel events and accounts.

sections.title: Acceptable use
p: Do not try to break, overload or misuse the service, other people’s accounts or the data in it.
list: No automated bulk purchases or scraping that harms the site.
No abusive, unlawful or misleading comments and messages.

sections.title: Changes and contact
p: These sample terms can change at any time. For questions, use the contact page.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lead: Sample text about what Ticketzy stores and why.

sections.title: About this page
p: This is sample text while Ticketzy is under development. It is not a real privacy policy and not legal advice. It describes what the service stores.

sections.title: Data stored
p: The database stores the following, only to make the features work:
list: Account: name or nickname, email, a hashed password, role (buyer, organizer or admin) and, if you add them, a photo and organizer profile details.
Orders, simulated payments, tickets and refunds, including seats and check-in status.
Likes, comments and notifications.
Messages between organizers and administrators.
Events, venues and images created by organizers.

sections.title: Payments
p: No payment details are collected. There is no card form, and no payment provider receives anything.

sections.title: Cookies and local storage
p: Ticketzy does not set cookies of its own. It uses the storage of your browser:
list: Local storage: the login token (accessToken), your language (locale), your theme (ticketzy-theme) and whether you closed the notice (ticketzy-demo-notice).
Session storage, which is cleared when the tab closes: the assistant conversation (ticketzy-assistant), a clock offset for the seat countdown (tz:clock-skew) and unsent form drafts.
You can clear all of it in your browser settings. You will then need to log in again.

sections.title: AI assistant
p: Text you type to the assistant is sent to the Ticketzy server, which asks an AI model for the reply. Do not type personal, payment or secret information.

sections.title: Sharing
p: Your data is not sold and not shared with advertisers or analytics services. Organizers see the orders and attendees of their own events. Comments, likes and organizer profiles are visible to other visitors.

sections.title: Keeping and deleting
p: Data can be reset at any time while the project is under development. There is no self-service account deletion yet. Ask through the contact page.

sections.title: Contact
p: Use the contact page for questions about this sample policy.
